enrichment.headline: Creates job descriptions for a Charter Schools Community Liaison and a Career Technical Education Program Manager
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts Resolution No. 2021-0106, which creates two job descriptions: Community Liaison, Charter Schools, and Program Manager, Career Technical Education. No dollar amount is stated in the item.

pulled.summary: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (6–1), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

items.title: Creation of Job Descriptions - Community Liaison, Charter Schools and Program Manager, Career Technical Education - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Adds $17,558 to Bay Area Community Resources' after school support at Futures Elementary
enrichment.summary: This changes a 2020-21 memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Bay Area Community Resources, adding $17,558 for virtual after school and school-day support at Futures Elementary School. The support covers academic help, enrichment, physical activity and community building. The not-to-exceed amount rises from $120,792 to $138,350 for August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant; After School Education and Safety (ASES) Kids Code Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021 - Bay Area Community Resources - After School Program - Futures Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Adds $15,238 to Bay Area Community Resources for extra staff and driver's education at Rudsdale
enrichment.summary: This changes a 2020-21 memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Bay Area Community Resources, adding $15,238. The money pays for another staff member to increase daytime academic support and for a driver's education class twice a week at Rudsdale Continuation School. The not-to-exceed amount rises from $132,785 to $148,023 for July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021.

enrichment.headline: Adds $10,397 for East Bay Asian Youth Center after school tutoring at Urban Promise Academy
enrichment.summary: This is the second change to a 2020-21 memorandum of understanding (MOU) with East Bay Asian Youth Center. It adds $10,397 to hire an after school teacher who gives one-to-one academic help to up to twelve newcomer and/or special education students, four hours a day, at Urban Promise Academy. The not-to-exceed amount rises from $135,306 to $145,703 for August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
